CustomField.description: IM-192: Formula field to show Initiative in Pipeline list view
CustomField.formula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Initiative_Type__c, 'New') , ISPICKVAL(Initiative_Type__c, 'Renewal') , ISPICKVAL(Initiative_Type__c, 'Amendment') ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , 'In Development') , ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Ready for Approval') ) )
CustomField.label: Include In Pipeline
